Big Challenge! Dogfight Spirit.name: Big Challenge! Dogfight Spirit
Big Challenge! Dogfight Spirit.summary: The player controls a blue helicopter fighting against waves of enemy vehicles and ground turrets. Each mission takes the helicopter to a different part of the world

Galaxian.name: Galaxian
Galaxian.summary: The Famicom port of Galaxian, which did not release internationally on the NES. This version was released in both cartridge and FDS disk form.
